div.p: What the confidante, who had decided on [their] going away together, said to HER.

lg.l: naṉṉeṭuṅ katuppoṭu peruntō ṇīviya
niṉṉiva ṇoḻita lañciya veṉṉiṉuñ
celavutalaik koṇṭa peruvitup puṟuvi
palkavar maruppiṉ mutumāṉ pōkkic
cilluṇāt tanta cīṟūrp peṇtir
tirivayiṟ ṟevuṭṭuñ cēek kuṭiñaip
paital meṉkura laituvan ticaittoṟum
pōkunar pulampu māṟē yēkutaṟ
kariya vākumeṉ ṉāmaik karimaraṅ
kaṇṇakai yiḷaṅkuḻai kāṉamuṟa kaviṉi
vicumpuṭa ṉiruṇṭu vemmai nīṅkap
pacuṅkaṇ vāṉam pāytuḷi poḻinteṉap
puṉṉukum peṭutta naṉṉeṭuṅ kāṉat
tūṭṭu pañcip picirparan taṉṉa
vuṇṇā mūtāy taṇṇilam parippa
viṉiya vākuka taṇintē
yiṉṉā nīppi ṉiṉṉoṭu celaṟkē.
She is one who has [even] greater haste to resort to going [away]
than me who is afraid of staying behind here, [going with] you
who stroked [her] big shoulder along with [her] good long hair.
The ways that are lonely for those who go [there]
– [such as] the women from the small village who bring a little food
after driving off the old stag with many-forked antlers –
whenever the sad soft voice sounds, coming wonderfully,
of the red rock-horned owl that makes noise at the crossings(?),
without saying that they are difficult to go,
turning beautiful when the forest has young shoots, [their] points of growth opening on the charred trees,
while the heat leaves as soon as the sky darkens,
because spreading drops flow from the clouds on green areas,
in the good tall forest that raises low banana leaves,
while feeding cochineals run over the cool ground
that spread like dyed cotton fibres,
let them be pleasing, having cooled down,
for going with you, unpleasant if you leave [alone].
